HAMCO Warehousing Portal

One flow from inquiry to invoice
How this is arranged
Operations is the warehouse: one WMS module covering job files, receiving, stock and dispatch.
Company holds shared services — people, assets, utilities, procurement, compliance — owned by the organisation, not by a warehouse.
Administration holds approvals and access control.

Home

Simple logistics WMS for own and outsourced warehousing.

Access Level: L2 Employee | Assigned customers only

One Warehousing Portal

One simple place for customer registration, existing customer search, inquiry, quotation, contract, job file, cargo statement, GRN, GDN, billing, approvals and closure. The screen stays easy, but the full process is available step by step.

Smart WMS
Inquiry → Invoice

1 Customer Relation Management

Register new customer separately, search existing customer separately, and open new or existing jobs from the customer account.

2 Inquiry

Select city, own or outsourced warehouse, storage nature and multiple services required by the customer.

3 Quotation

Prepare full warehousing quotation, billing cycle and optional commercial figure/trend view.

4 Job File

Contract, GRN, GDN, cargo statement, invoice, warehouse details and approvals stay in one job file.

L1 Customer

Read-only access

Customer can only view/download contract copy, GRN, GDN, cargo statement and selling invoices.

L2 Employee

Assigned customers only

Employee sees only assigned customers and can process from customer/job to billing.

L3 Admin

Full control

Admin has full rights, approvals, amendments, access control, contract changes and override rights.

Job Rotation

Temporary coverage

Admin can temporarily assign another employee to customer jobs during leave or absence.

Customer Relation Management - New & Existing

Registered and existing customers are now managed under one searchable customer list. Select a customer to take a new job number or continue an existing job.

Register the customer once. The system issues a Customer ID and the customer appears in the Existing Customer List. Saudi and international companies can be registered from the same compact form.

Customer Location

Select country, city and sub-city / district. Saudi companies can also capture the National Address short code.
Required pattern for Saudi short address demo: 4 alphabets + 4 digits.

Nature of Business / Services Category *

Checkbox selection allows multiple services for the same customer.

If the customer requires any service except the listed categories, add it here and it will be saved with this customer profile.

Selected services will reflect in customer master, quotation, contract, job file and billing setup.

Inquiry, Warehouse & Service Selection

Select the city, warehouse source, storage nature and all service types required for the customer. The job nature remains open because every customer may use different services over time.

Job Nature / Required Services

Outsourced Warehouse Cost & Selling

Use this only when the warehouse service is taken from a partner/vendor. Own warehouse jobs do not need vendor costing.


Quotation + Contract Draft Builder

Give the customer a full quotation with all possible services. The relevant contract draft is attached automatically based on the selected nature of job/service, and invoices are charged as per actual utilization and agreed billing cycle.

Standard Quotation Heads

Service HeadBilling UnitRateMinimumRemarks
Quotation details use the same customer registration and billing information. When the contract is issued, the approved quotation is saved as a snapshot inside the job file.

Billing & Invoice

Invoice is based on quotation and contract. Own warehouse does not require vendor costing. Outsourced warehouse requires vendor cost + selling + margin.

ChargeBasisAmount
Storage100 pallet × 30 days × agreed rateAs per quotation
Inbound HandlingAs per GRN utilizationAs per quotation
Outbound HandlingAs per GDN utilizationAs per quotation
Additional ServicesOnly if used/approvedAs agreed
Vendor CostOnly if outsourcedAs per partner invoice

Access Levels L1 / L2 / L3

Select an access level to see what opens for the customer, employee or admin. This is the working demo for permission-based portal access.

L1 Customer - Read Only

Allowed

View contract copy, GRN, GDN, cargo statement, inventory/stock and selling invoices only.

Not Allowed

No edit, no upload, no stock change, no invoice approval, no internal comments and no vendor cost.

Go Further

L2 Employee - Assigned Customers Only

Assigned Customers

Apex Medical Trading, Gulf Food Logistics, Nova Cosmetics based on employee portfolio.

Can Work

Customer selection, new job number, inquiry, quotation draft, contract upload, job file, GRN/GDN/cargo statement and billing preparation.

Go Further

L3 Admin - Full Rights

Full Control

Read/write all customers, all jobs, approvals, amendments, contract changes, access control and override with audit trail.

Approvals

Approve invoice exceptions, contract amendments, case-to-case billing, stock adjustments and employee job rotation access.

Go Further

Job Rotation / Temporary Coverage

Every action during temporary coverage is recorded with original owner, temporary user, reason, approval person and expiry date.

Approvals & Billing Control

Invoice approval is assigned to the responsible person. Case-to-case billing can be added with logic, reason and approval. Management can also see margin, secured-job trend and revenue by warehouse kind.
